acceptanceCriteria: Pi 0.87 passes integrations/pi native host tests and is admitted with compatibility evidence.
body: Found by the 2026-09-27 adapter audit for rc.2. cmd/corvint/pi_adapter.go:84 refuses every host version except piHostVersion (0.85.1) with unsupported-host-version, so users on current Pi get a degraded adapter. Qualify 0.87 with the native TUI host test and add it to the exact tested tuple.
title: Qualify Pi 0.87 for the Pi adapter
